explicit-invocation.means: only the user starts the capability; the model never selects it on its own

no-code-changes.means: the review leaves the reviewed code unchanged and writes only its report
no-code-changes.by: the skill writes only its report and tells subagents not to edit; checked by the contract

verified-findings.means: findings follow the fixed format and each names a concrete failure scenario
verified-findings.by: the procedure's verify step and fixed format; checked by the contract
